rationale: The assistant correctly read the evidence (one-sided loss of tension, twang, visible loose spring) to a failed right-hand door-balance spring/cable, matching the hidden truth, and sensibly declined to name a part from the 'LTF' prefix alone. It isolated power, told the customer to support the door and not remove covers, and escalated to an engineer because the integrated unit cannot be pulled out, with useful instructions for the engineer to compare both sides. Minor weaknesses: the first step re-asked the customer to confirm the door drops (already stated), 'not a latch fault' was repeated needlessly three times, and the model-number panel reappeared after the customer said the sticker was unreadable.
